draftPackage.topic: SS Ohio: the tanker brought into Malta between warships
draftPackage.centralQuestion: How did a disabled tanker reach Malta, and why did its cargo matter?
draftPackage.thesis: A changing team of escorts and local vessels brought a badly damaged tanker to Malta so its fuel could be delivered.
draftPackage.viewerPayoff: Understand the side-by-side assistance and why delivering the surviving fuel mattered more than recovering a working ship.

segments.text: This tanker reached Malta with a warship lashed to each side.
It was August nineteen forty-two. Malta was under siege, and desperately short of fuel.
Ohio was carrying thousands of tons.
A torpedo struck. Bomb attacks followed. Her engines failed, and water flooded in.
Towing her was a struggle: the damaged ship kept swinging off course.
So destroyers came alongside, securing the tanker between them, while other vessels helped with the tow.
On August fifteenth, Ohio entered Grand Harbour.
Her fuel was unloaded, helping Malta’s aircraft keep fighting.
The precious part of this wreck was still inside her.

misconceptionSafeguards: One intact seriously damaged hull throughout; no two halves.
No ship lifted completely from the sea, no quantified buoyancy, no exact lashings or recovered engineering diagram.
Changing towing arrangements compressed and labeled; two alongside plus another ahead, not only two rescuers.
Cargo thousands of tons, not an exact total or all aviation gasoline.
No invented casualties, dialogue, attack count or sole-saviour claim.
Archive black and white remains distinct from clearly labeled original reconstruction; no fake archival battle.
review.comprehensionReview: Opening names a tanker and visibly shows flanks; stakes established in one sentence; disabled engines and swinging tow motivate alongside assistance; unloading delivers specific payoff. Final precious part is an editorial metaphor for fuel, not a new historical event.
review.rightsReview: Four inspected official 1942 photographs from Commons, PD-scan/expired UK Crown copyright; IWM NC metadata is not the commercial permission relied on. Original drawing/audio, existing licensed fonts/Kokoro. RMG art and IWM licensed film excluded. See rights-provenance.

careAssessment.rationale: Historical logistics explanation; no glorified violence, invented battle footage or graphic casualties. Existing local capabilities and costs.
